query: How do I connect and consume real-time telemetry updates in Python?
output_text:
Here is how you consume live telemetry events using the Stream interface:
```python
from sdk import Stream

# Connect to live real-time telemetry events
stream = Stream.feed(channel="telemetry", buffer_len=1024, ping_interval=5000)
for event in stream:
    process(event)
```
This feeds real-time updates directly into your processing pipeline.
